This version adds a switch to disengage the octave so Add to cart SKU: KY0YRPXF Category: Pedals description shipping review Mystic Effects Co Octavia Vintage Octave Fuzz 1960s style fuzz with switchable octave effect The Octavia is an homage to the classic 1967 Roger Mayer transformer based octave fuzz design of the same name. This version adds a switch to disengage the octave sound for a more straight-forward classic transistor fuzz tone, and a control to tame the input signal to roll off some of the harsher fuzz overtones. Like most rectifying octave implementations, the octave up ringing can best be heard by playing up higher on the neck with the guitars tone control rolled off.
